calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, reverse its trailing three-day return and scale it by the positive surprise of cross-asset absolute-return dispersion over its trailing 60-day median. Demean across the available universe on each date. All inputs are lagged/completed daily prices.

parameters.activation: positive dispersion ratio surprise, clipped to [-1,2] before positive-part

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC across 2020-2022 (+0.057174), 2023 (+0.043035), 2025 (+0.043298), and 2026-07 onward (+0.032011); interpret conservatively because daily positive-IC hit ratio is 0.2967 and the cross-section is only 15 assets.
